movie_title: Talking about routines 🍽️🛌🚶 Real Easy English: Episode 6
introduction: Listen to Neil and Beth talk about their meal times in English – and learn some useful vocabulary fo

vocabulary.definition: the time and way we usually do something
vocabulary.example: I have a morning routine of exercising and meditating.

vocabulary.definition: feeling irritable or angry due to hunger
vocabulary.example: I become hangry if I skip lunch.

vocabulary.definition: a meal that combines breakfast and lunch
vocabulary.example: Let's have brunch together this Sunday.
Drinking water as soon as I wake up is a habit of mine.

vocabulary.definition: used to talk about a habit in the past
vocabulary.example: I used to play the piano when I was younger.

vocabulary.definition: used to talk about past habits
vocabulary.example: When I was in college, I would study late into the night.
